records.subject: You're in -- let's get Timber Group set up
records.body:
Hi Jordan,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old with no project, no invite, no milestone despite a held onboarding call [calendar:18f3759a] and welcome email [email:0e8cca5d]. No customer reply or tickets signals low engagement, but the attended call shows some intent, so moderate-low chance of self-serve activation in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: One first project for Timber Group
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the getting-started call last week. Picking up where we left off: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so creating one project with a few real tasks is usually the quickest way to see whether it fits how Timber Group works. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Want me to walk through that first project with you on a short call this week? Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Chidi
